mechanism: The use of solution-processable semiconductors in tandem architectures would allow for the creation of large-area photovoltaics with improved power conversion efficiency, as the tandem structure enables better utilization of the solar spectrum and the solution-processable semiconductors enable low-cost manufacturing. constraint_released: The constraint of high production costs is released, enabling the widespread adoption of photovoltaic technology.
